brief_title: Endothelial Disfunction Treatment With Glimepiride/Metformin Combination (Glimetal) in Type 2 Diabetes Patients
official_title: Endothelial Disfunction Treatment With Glimepiride/Metformin Combination (Glimetal) in Type 2 Diabetes Patients. Positron Emission Tomography Assessment(PET)
brief_summary: The Purpose of this study was to evaluate the effect of the combination glimepiride/metformin over endothelial dysfunction (ED) in asymptomatic patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (DM) using 13N-ammonia-positron emission tomography (PET).

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Both genders
* At least 18 years old
* Type 2 diabetes mellitus diagnosis
* Signed Informed Consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of smoking, hypertension, dyslipidemia, ischemic heart disease or autoimmune rheumatic diseases
* Pregnancy or lactation
* History of abuse and/or substance dependence within 6 months preceding the survey.
* History of glimepiride or metformin allergy
